LT-99482.summary: Add “Lesson Calendar” button to Trial Lesson page
LT-99482.descriptionText:
Add the same button to Trial Lesson Detail page.
 
Ask Order team to review as Trial Lesson is under Order team.

---
Add a 'Lesson Calendar' navigation button to the Trial Lesson record screen to streamline the workflow for assigning students to lesson slots. Currently, the button is available on application screens but missing from the Trial Lesson record. The expected behavior is for users to be able to navigate directly to the calendar after creating a trial lesson.
Issue created in Slack from a message.
